verdict.rationale: Docs show the Customer Agent can connect tools to any API (Stripe, internal endpoints) and both agents share connections, which enables pulling live account/order data rather than just static knowledge articles, but no concrete example or case study shows it actually surfacing plan/order-status/account-history data in an answer. missing for 10: a documented example or customer case showing live account/order lookups in a real resolution, and specifics on how live data is merged into agent responses vs. knowledge base content.
